faq.q: Is the trial lesson really free?
faq.a: Yes. Your first lesson is free, with no payment details and no obligation. If it isn't the right fit, you simply walk away.

faq.q: Which subjects and curriculums do you cover?
faq.a: Maths, Physics, Chemistry, Biology, Statistics, English, Economics and Computer Science. We teach the American curriculum (including AP), Indian CBSE and ISC, British IGCSE, GCSE, O Level and A Level, IB, Australian Years 4–12 (NAPLAN, HSC, VCE) and university courses.

faq.q: Do you prepare students for entry tests?
faq.a: Yes. We prepare students for the SAT, IMAT, BMAT and UCAT, from full prep courses to last-minute crash courses, with timed practice papers and score tracking. Please check your target university's current requirements, as some no longer accept every test.

faq.q: How do you choose my child's tutor?
faq.a: We don't leave it to chance or a search filter. Our team matches a tutor to the subject, curriculum or test, your child's level and learning style, and your preferred times. If the fit isn't right, we'll switch tutors for free.

faq.q: Where are you based, and who do you teach?
faq.a: We're based in the UAE and teach students all over the world. Most of our students are in the Gulf (UAE, Saudi Arabia, Qatar, Kuwait, Bahrain and Oman), the UK, Australia, New Zealand, the USA and Canada. Lessons are always scheduled in your own timezone.

faq.q: How do online lessons work?
faq.a: Lessons run live, one-to-one, by video call with a shared whiteboard. All you need is a laptop or tablet with a camera and a stable internet connection.

faq.q: Can we cancel or reschedule a lesson?
faq.a: Yes. Reschedule or cancel any lesson with at least 24 hours' notice, and the hour stays in your balance.

faq.q: How will I know it's working?
faq.a: You'll get notes after every lesson and a written progress report every month showing strengths, gaps and the plan ahead. For entry tests, we also share your practice-test scores.

faq.q: Can I teach with SAS Tutors?
faq.a: Yes. Tap "Teach with us" in the menu to apply. We review every application, then hold a short interview and a demo lesson.

faq.q: How many hours have you taught?
faq.a: More than 5,000 hours of one-to-one lessons so far.

faq.q: Do you teach students in Dubai, Abu Dhabi, Sharjah and the rest of the UAE?
faq.a: Yes. Every lesson is online, so it doesn't matter which emirate you're in.

faq.q: Do you teach students in Saudi Arabia, Qatar, Kuwait, Bahrain and Oman?
faq.a: Yes. We teach students in all of these countries, with lessons scheduled at times that suit your school day.

faq.q: Do you teach students in the UK, Australia, New Zealand, the USA and Canada?
faq.a: Yes. Lessons are online and scheduled in your own timezone, so you can learn from anywhere in the world.

faq.q: Which curriculums do you teach?
faq.a: American, British (IGCSE, GCSE, O and A Level), IB, Indian (CBSE and ISC) and Australian. Wherever your school's international programme is offered, we can teach it.

faq.q: How much do lessons cost?
faq.a: Lessons cost $20 an hour on the 20-hour plan, $15 an hour on the 50-hour plan and $10 an hour on the 100-hour plan. Your first lesson is free.

faq.q: Is the plan tied to a subject, tutor or curriculum?
faq.a: No. Your hours work for any subject, any tutor on our team, and any school, university, curriculum or board. You can mix and match as you go.

faq.q: Do my hours expire?
faq.a: No. Hours you buy never expire.

faq.q: Can I share hours with my siblings or family?
faq.a: Yes. You can transfer hours to siblings or other family members, free of charge.

faq.q: Can I get a refund on unused hours?
faq.a: Yes. If a year or more has passed since you bought your hours and you haven't used them, you can request a refund for the unused hours.

faq.q: Can I pay in instalments?
faq.a: Bundles are paid in full. If a larger plan doesn't suit your budget, you can start with a smaller plan, though the hourly rate will be a little higher.

faq.q: Which payment methods and currencies do you accept?
faq.a: We accept payments from all regions. Our rates are in US dollars and are converted to your local currency at checkout.

faq.q: What if I only want a few lessons before committing to a bundle?
faq.a: We have flexible options for that. Message our admin team on WhatsApp and they'll arrange it for you.
